summary_1line: Various sages and deities describe religious taboos, rituals, and household conduct that bring merit or sin, especially regarding guests, cows, lunar rites, and offerings.

image_candidates.scene_text: Seven ancient Rishis led by Vasishtha stand with folded hands around the lotus-born Brahman after circumambulating him in reverence.
A devotee stands under the open night sky during the bright fortnight, gazing upward and 'drinking' the rays of the full moon.
A worshipper offers a palmful of water and rice mixed with ghee to the glowing full moon while standing beneath its light.
